title: Quiet genlock output in coding sessions: record changes show as one line like Added task "TITLE" or Changed status of TITLE, with no record-file diffs or JSON

requirements.text: After a genlock command in a Claude Code session, no 'Created .genlock/records/...' or 'Updated .genlock/records/...' lines or record JSON appear in the transcript
requirements.check: manual: run genlock review and genlock new in a driven session; read the transcript for .genlock/records lines

requirements.text: Each genlock command that changes records prints one summary line such as Added task "TITLE" or Changed status of TITLE
requirements.check: manual: same transcript shows exactly one such line per command

requirements.text: The cause of the record-file display is named in the task's latest, with where it comes from (genlock hook, Claude Code file display, or other)
requirements.check: genlock show the task: latest names the source

text: Cause: Claude Code's own bash edit diff (setting bashEditDiffEnabled, on by default in auto mode): after each Bash command it git-diffs the tree and puts changed files in tool_response.bashEditDiff, which the transcript renders. Not a genlock hook or genlock printing. Fix: genlock deliver (the PostToolUse hook in every genlock project) returns updatedToolOutput without .genlock files plus a systemMessage line per record (lib/quiet.mjs). Ships to other projects when the app is rebuilt.

evidence: latest names the source: Claude Code bash edit diff (toolUseResult.bashEditDiff in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tj-nightmaremode/ef18b9c4...jsonl line 4131 lists R-36CB7.jsonl with +{record JSON}); grep of genlock bin/lib found no such printing

headless claude -p session (scratchpad/exp, bashEditDiffEnabled true, PostToolUse = dev genlock deliver): transcript toolUseResult for 'genlock new' has no bashEditDiff; for 'genlock start fence; echo y >> a.txt' bashEditDiff lists only a.txt. Replaying TJ's R-36CB7 diffs through deliver: diff removed. tests/run.mjs 601 passed; with the filter broken 5 quiet checks fail

same headless transcript: hook_system_message 'Added task "gate-hinge"' after genlock new, 'Changed status of fence to started' after genlock start, one each; R-36CB7 replay -> 'Asked for review of docs/library/interior_split_level_garage.png'

answers.observed: stored transcript entries from a real claude -p run, cited above
answers.cause: measured: bashEditDiff present in tool_response, and removed from the stored result only when the hook returns updatedToolOutput
answers.absence: not checked: how the interactive TUI renders hook_system_message (prefix/style), and the app-bundled copy still runs old code until rebuilt
answers.assumption: mine: that the interactive transcript renders from the same toolUseResult the -p transcript stores
answers.falsify: after an app rebuild, an auto-mode genlock review in nightmaremode still shows Created .genlock/records/...
